scope: Linux native WebKitGTK development app, existing profile; no media writes
runtime: WebKitGTK 2.54, existing 1.4.7 native binary with candidate frontend; new native protocol tested separately

scripted_scroll_paint_comparison.method: 2.2-second triangular native scroll per variant; wait two animation frames after changing CSS; retain stage, restore original scroll and remove all temporary styles

chosen_change: Layout and paint containment on the existing rectangular native scrollport. No table mask, forced GPU transform or change to field values.
regressions: 53 and 371 loaded rows retain identity with zero table mutations during scrolling
20000-file disjoint jumps retain the table body and spacers, never replaceChildren on the body, remain under 100 mounted track rows and contain visible rows
A synchronous scroll reset after a model rebuild cannot strand the viewport above a stale virtual window
limits: Short controlled comparisons on one Linux machine establish this rendering improvement, not universal frame-time or native scanning-throughput guarantees. An outlier remained in the first contained confirmation run. Windows/macOS GUI and new-native-binary live editing are not claimed by these measurements.
